title: Failure envelope
description: The stable error taxonomy: stage, failure code, retryability, remediation hint, and provenance. An execution failure carries no fabricated scientific verdict. Implementation plan WP-09 task 8.

remediation.const: Re-run acquisition for this product, then re-validate it.
The file is truncated, corrupted, or a different version. Re-download it and compare against the acquisition manifest before re-validating.
Check the label against the archive copy. If it is valid but exceeds a size or recursion limit, raise that limit deliberately rather than disabling it.
Do not process this product. Establish which of the two is authoritative with the data provider and re-acquire.
Treat the product as untrusted and quarantined. Report it; do not relax the parser to accept it.
Convert the product to an allow-listed format, or extend the allow-list only after reviewing that driver's parsing surface.
Confirm the payload is one of OHRC, TMC-2, or IIRS. Other payloads are out of scope for the MVP.
Supply the calibrated product level named in the payload adapter documentation.
The input may be a decompression bomb. Inspect it before raising any limit.
Acquire reference imagery for this region, or choose a different route.
Complete the reference bundle manifest. An unversioned reference cannot support a reproducible claim.
SLDEM2015 is limited to roughly 60 degrees south to 60 degrees north. Select LOLA or an appropriate polar product for this latitude.
Either supply a named control realisation with its uncertainty, or request image-relative metrics only.
Furnish reconstructed kernels spanning the interval and re-validate the product.
IIRS geometry remains unvalidated pending D-004. Use a qualified route, or record the result as experimental.
Do not trust the prior. Investigate kernel priority, timing, and the sensor model before proceeding.
Select a reference product that covers the source scene.
Resolve ADR-0002 for this latitude band before processing the scene.
Check illumination difference, GSD ratio, and eligible area in the preflight report. This scene may be outside every qualified route.
Inspect the eligibility mask. A low-sun scene may have no mutually usable area.
The metadata prior is not bounding this scene (R-003). Widen the bounded coarse search deliberately, or add a coarse pre-alignment step.
The classical fallback should have been used and recorded. Check device availability and the pinned weights hash.
Inspect patch texture and peak ambiguity. Low-texture terrain may not support sub-pixel refinement at this scale.
These matches are unusable for uncertainty-weighted adjustment and are dropped with a recorded reason.
Disagreement means neither estimate is trustworthy here. Review the residual map before accepting the scene.
Clustered matches cannot constrain a terrain-aware adjustment. Check the eligibility mask and the largest empty region.
Select a reference product with greater overlap.
Reduce the parameter set or regularise from documented priors (R-009). Do not accept an unobservable solution.
Inspect outlier fraction and conditioning. Convergence failure often means the correspondence set is contaminated.
The route is not qualified for this stratum. This is a scientific result, not a malfunction.
Check storage availability and permissions, then retry the stage.
This is a defect in the writer. The partial output was not published.
Storage may be faulty. Retry; if it recurs, the storage backend is suspect.
Unknown parameters are rejected rather than ignored, because an ignored parameter silently changes nothing while appearing to change something. Correct the parameter file.
A missing applicable hard-gate metric is a rejection, not a pass. Supply the missing evidence or accept the rejection.
Qualify the route on the frozen benchmark before using it on a scene.
This is a defect. Use the named conversion functions rather than an inline correction.
Reduce the tile core size or raise the declared budget deliberately.
Free space or point the run at a larger volume, then resume from the last completed stage.
Retry. If it recurs at the same stage, the limit is too tight for this input size and should be raised deliberately.
Retry, or run the classical CPU route, which remains a first-class path.
Completed stages remain reusable. Resume the run to continue from the last atomically completed stage.
This is a defect. The stack trace is in the run log; the failure is not retried automatically because its cause is unknown.
